traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md is clearly a concrete specification for deep requirement validation and is implemented via the valid-req-reference rule.
Mapping to acceptance criteria: - Core Functionality: Implemented and verified. The rule resolves story paths from annotations, parses the referenced story files for `REQ-...` identifiers, and validates that every `@req` and each ID in `@supports` exists in the corresponding story file. Tests cover both valid and missing requirement scenarios. - Quality Standards: The implementation supports multiple story structures and formats via content-wide regex scanning, with explicit tests for base story files, bullet-list requirements, and multi-story fixtures. This covers the intended “various formats and structures” even though it uses a lightweight parsing strategy rather than a full markdown AST. - Integration: The rule is part of the plugin’s rule set and recommended/strict configs, and it uses the same annotation model (`@story`, `@req`, `@supports`) as the rest of the traceability rules. There is no evidence of conflicts, and tests for other dependency stories (005, 006, 007, 010.2) all pass concurrently. - User Experience: Error messages are specific and contextual (`reqMissing`, `invalidPath`), and tests assert the correct message IDs and data payloads, ensuring clear feedback when requirements are missing or paths are invalid. - Error Handling: File read errors are caught and turned into safe behavior (empty requirement sets) instead of crashes, and unsafe paths are detected and reported. This satisfies the requirement to handle malformed or inaccessible story files gracefully. - Documentation: docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md documents the deep validation behavior, path checks, scoping rules, and provides concrete examples, clearly aligning with this story.
On balance, all acceptance criteria and named requirements for 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION are implemented with tests and documentation, so this story is considered fully implemented (PASSED).
